evals.prompt: Troubleshoot three `asm-exec` operational issues hit by developers: (1) `asm-exec: MCP resolution failed: HTTP 401`, (2) `asm-exec: MCP resolution failed: timed out after 30s`, and (3) `asm-exec` exits `0` cleanly but `DB_PASSWORD` resolves to an empty string `""`!
